description: Decentralised frequency inverter (motor mounted) with Modbus RTU: monitoring, ramps and references, motor control, I/O, protections, serial, SoftPLC and network parameters
source: WEG MW500 programming manual, 10002170331 / 06, software V2.1X
notes: Every parameter Pxxxx is the holding register of the same number (P0003 is register 3). Functions 03, 06 and 16.
Values travel as integers: a parameter shown as 1.5 A is sent as 15. Scales follow the decimal places of the parameter table of the programming manual.
Parameters with several ranges, hexadecimal words or values that do not fit one register are shown raw, with the documented values in the description.
Serial defaults: address 1 (P0308), 19200 bit/s (P0310), 8 data bits, even parity, 1 stop bit (P0311).
The newer MW500 G2 has its own manual and is not covered.
Written from the manufacturer's programming manual; not tested on a device.

application.0: The inverter is mounted on the motor for applications at ambient temperature of 40 °C (104 °F)
application.1: The inverter is mounted on the motor for applications at ambient temperature of 50 °C (122 °F), or on a flat surface for applications at ambient temperature of 40 °C (104 °F)
